info.name: KU Leuven Research Data Repository (RDR) Access API

description.content: Dataverse-based institutional research data repository API for KU Leuven (rdr.kuleuven.be), running Dataverse 6.7.1. Public info endpoints are reachable without authentication; write operations require an API token, a registered ORCID, and the Dataset Creator role.
